_comment: Curated component library for the eCAD product catalog.
Every product BOM composes parts from this file by key, so a component
carries the same manufacturer, part number, package and unit cost in every
design that uses it. tools/generate_products.py computes extended costs and
BOM totals from these figures, which is why no cost is ever typed into a
EVIDENCE CLASS: Assumed. Unit costs are order-of-magnitude estimates at
roughly qty-100 distributor pricing and were NOT retrieved from a live
distributor API. Part numbers were authored from domain knowledge and have
NOT been checked against a manufacturer catalogue. Before any of this data
is used for procurement or quoting, every MPN and price needs verifying
does not claim to check either -- it proves internal consistency only.

A component with "assembly": true is part of the product but is NOT mounted on the PCB (enclosure, battery pack, solar panel, the bare board itself, panel-mount antenna, external module). It appears in the BOM and its cost counts, but it is excluded from board placement and area checks.
